_help: HOW TO USE: copy this file to 'config.json' (same folder), edit the numbers, then restart the game.
Delete a line (or the whole file) to go back to the default for that value.
Keys starting with an underscore, like this one, are ignored. JSON has no comments, so notes live here.
Values shown are the current defaults. Whole numbers stay whole (start_rabbits), others may have decimals.
Keep the file valid JSON: commas between lines, none after the last line. If it is broken the game silently uses defaults.
Challenges use their own starting animals; start_rabbits / start_foxes only affect the sandbox.
Test a change without playing:  python tests/balance.py 20 1000 start_foxes=3
_world: Starting animals and speed. Do not change cols/rows: the window layout is fixed to 30 x 20.
_rabbits: Energy 0-100. Rabbits die at 0 energy or max age.
_foxes: fox_hungry_below: a fox only hunts when its energy is under this. fox_detect_radius: how many cells it can see.
